text:
jamal: FYI postdeploy synthetic on rerank route (us-west2) is spiking 429s. baseline ~0.2% -> current 6%. noticed right after the canary batch.

deploy-bot: Deploy summary: release-2026-03-22-2 started 2026-03-22T18:05Z. Target: api-prod. Rollout progress: 70%. Canary checks OK. Post-deploy synth: ALERT. See: https://deploy/release-2026-03-22-2

nora: confirming in dashboards, upstream 429s mapped to reranker pool on us-west2-a. latency stable but rate-limit errors increasing. probably a capacity or token-bucket mismatch with new batching.

li: tailing proxy logs on us-west2-a: getting repeated 429s with rate-limiter reason header. snippet:
```
[2026-03-22T18:07:11Z] proxy pid=5521 WARN upstream 429 "x-rw-reason=rate-limit" route=/v1/rerank host=us-west2-a
[2026-03-22T18:07:11Z] reranker pid=3332 INFO batch_size=32 in-flight=120
```

maria: is this contained to us-west2? can we regionally reduce concurrency or pin to lower-batch variant? we don't want a full rollback if it's capacity config.

devops-bot: Suggested mitigations:
- throttle clients in us-west2 (traffic-shed 10%)
- pin /v1/rerank in us-west2 to `rerank-1.2` (stable)
- rollback reranker image (last resort)

nora: temporary throttle + pin seems safest. pinning will avoid the new batching path until root cause investigated.

jamal: agree. implementing regional pin for rerank and a small client throttle. running command:
```
redwoodctl route pin --region us-west2 --route /v1/rerank --model rerank-1.2 --reason "postdeploy rate-limiter regression" --by jamal
redwoodctl traffic adjust --region us-west2 --percent 90 --reason "temporary throttle to reduce burst"
```

deploy-bot: Actions: pinned /v1/rerank -> rerank-1.2 in us-west2 (jamal @ 2026-03-22T18:12Z). Traffic adjusted: us-west2 -> 90% of pre-rollout load. Rollout progress remains 70% and is paused.

health-bot: starting targeted smoke: job-id=smoke-1839999999-rerank region=us-west2 samples=500 type=postdeploy-synth

li: I kicked a soft-restart on reranker instances in us-west2-a to clear any batch-queue buildup. no config change.

health-bot: smoke job progress: 250/500 sampled -> 429 rate down to 0.6% (lowered from 6%). continuing.

jamal: good sign. keep pinned and throttled for now. can we also add a quick note to release notes and change window so support knows this is intentionally pinned in us-west2?

maria: I'll add to release notes and annotate change window. quick snippet for notes: 
"Release-2026-03-22-2: regional pin applied to /v1/rerank in us-west2 due to post-deploy rate-limit regressions. Traffic throttled to 90% while investigation continues. No global rollback."

nora: agree on notes. also assign reranker eng to investigate batching token-bucket interaction in the new image. ping @li for logs.

health-bot: smoke job complete: job-id=smoke-1839999999-rerank results: 500 sampled, 3/500 429 (0.6%), p95=210ms, notes="pinned variant serving in region; throttling active"

devops-bot: auto-policy: if 429s < 1% for 15m, system will resume rollout to 85% in region. otherwise remain pinned and escalate.

jamal: setting manual hold until we get 30m of stable smoke. assigning follow-up: reranker team (tickets created) + postmortem to capture mitigation steps and whether canary preflight needs a batch-concurrency check.

maria: hold acknowledged. adding follow-up to release checklist and update support playbook. :spiral_note_pad: 

li: copying relevant log dump to ticket and starting reproducer with disabled batching (local) to see if token-bucket thresholds differ. will report back in 20m.

nora: thanks all. summary: regional pin + throttle applied, restart done, smoke looks good -> collect 30m of telemetry then resume. :thumbsup:
